## Reference quality control

Verified against published records:
- Anchor articles: titles, the Huang et al. author list and DOI, the Cecilio et al. DOI, and the Cecilio study details used in this book (*P. duboscqi*, *L. major*, feeding design, infection prevalence, R0 modeling).
- C.R.E.A.T.E.: Hoskins et al. (2007) volume, pages and DOI; Hoskins et al. (2011) title and DOI.
- Taxonomy: Wen et al. (1999) title and DOI; Shigematsu et al. (2003) volume, pages and DOI; *The Delftia Book* authorship.
- Methods resources: Cumming et al. (2007), Janda & Abbott (2007), PubChem harman (CID 5281404), the WHO leishmaniasis fact sheet, and the CDC malaria life-cycle page.

Not independently confirmed (check before publication):
- The Cecilio et al. article number (16:3571), taken from the course documents; the DOI is verified.
- The volume and page range for Hoskins et al. (2011), and the end page for Wen et al. (1999), which are omitted above.
- The WHO malaria fact sheet and teachcreate.org links, and the ASM Gram stain protocol, which has no stable URL in this book.
